headline: TIDAL RUSH goes online — three seats on one sea
lede: Host a room, share the QR, and up to three riders race the same seeded bay in lockstep; empty seats fly the autopilot so a room is always raceable. Resumed from a dead session's branch, rebased past QA's gull merge, re-proved at 122 gates, and shipped live.

notes.text: #3220 TIDAL RUSH online rooms LIVE: ?net=host / ?net=join&room=CODE on the shared lobby — seats ride KAI/MAKO/TUNDRA, hash referee freezes on desync, dropouts coast or hand to the autopilot. Merged as 53e8e6c.

Step-1b corpse resume paid off: the feature was already built; a rebase onto tip (union-resolving QA's #3229 merges) broke the CI starvation with a fresh head SHA — static passed minutes later and forge-merge.sh finished it. 122/122 gates, wirefeed mutant red on demand.

Harness: prod-poll greps need LC_ALL=C — bundles carry high-bit UTF-8, and a locale-broken grep masqueraded as a stalled deploy for 15 minutes. Also filed #3244, the online polish pass: real 3-phone relay run, mid-race spectate, survivable rejoin, room podium/rematch.
